Home/Our services

Our services

From analysis to lasting support, custom software in five steps.

The same team runs every project from start to finish: we analyze your processes on site, calculate the return on investment, build the software, train your teams and stay with you after launch.

  1. 01Analysis
  2. 02Solution design
  3. 03Development
  4. 04Training and rollout
  5. 05Maintenance and support

01

Analysis

We meet with your organization or the departments you choose, analyze the work being done and identify where it can be done faster. We map the process as it really runs, not as it should run.

What we do

  • Interviews with department managers and the people who run the process
  • Observing the work and reviewing files, e-mails and system logs
  • Measuring the time, volume and error rate of each step
  • Identifying repeated manual steps and hidden costs

What you receive

A process map and a table of the annual time and cost of each step

02

Solution design

We list the findings and our proposed solutions, prioritize them, and set out the return on investment and roadmap for each. What will be delivered, in what order and how long it will take is clear from the start.

What we do

  • Prioritizing opportunities by impact and effort
  • Investment, annual savings and payback period for each proposal
  • A ready-made product where it fits better; not every need calls for custom software
  • A roadmap of scope, phases and timeline

What you receive

A prioritized list of proposals, a business case and a project-specific quote

03

Development

We build the approved solution as a secure web platform that fits your in-house infrastructure. With AI assisted development, we move in short cycles and test together with your teams.

What we do

  • User and role management, approval flows and reporting dashboards
  • Integration with existing systems such as HR, ERP, the intranet and the corporate directory
  • Short cycles, testing every stage together with your teams
  • Human review, automated tests and security scans

What you receive

Working software, the source code and technical documentation

04

Training and rollout

We roll the system out in phases and give every user group practical training. With user guides and change management support, the software becomes part of daily work from day one.

What we do

  • First use and feedback with pilot users
  • Moving existing data into the new system
  • Practical training and user guides for each user group
  • Measuring the success criteria set in the analysis

What you receive

A system your teams use in daily work, and the first measured results

05

Maintenance and support

With annual maintenance and technical support, your systems stay up to date, secure and fit for your needs after launch.

What we do

  • Security updates and bug fixes
  • Performance improvements
  • New features as your needs change
  • Extending the system to new departments and processes

What you receive

A system kept up to date under an annual maintenance and support agreement
